name: Löwen Entertainment
note: Main sponsor of 1. FC Kaiserslautern since 2024-25; its Novoline brand is on the front of the shirt. Not rated yet: the ownership claim (loewen-entertainment-ownership) only identifies the legal entity from its legal notice (LÖWEN ENTERTAINMENT GmbH, Bingen, Mainz Local Court HRB 23327), not who owns it. Löwen’s own site (https://www.loewen.de/gruppe/loewen-gruppe/, opened 2026-10-01) says it has been part of NOVOMATIC AG since 2003 (“Seit 2003 sind wir Teil der NOVOMATIC AG”); who owns NOVOMATIC AG isn’t sourced yet. It needs sourced claims for both steps before it can be rated.
